Receipt selection can prefer a matching executable, then configured/default editor choices; the wrapper checks the expected staged target receipt independently. BuildPlugins supplies optional-dependency information and is not itself a runtime enablement list. The runtime project's default allowance assignment differs from the UBT conjunction in the general case; the reviewed candidate's source-supported default case agrees.

Read complete BODY094 and BODY058. Normal startup dispatches project modules before plugin modules for PreDefault, Default and PostDefault, with short-circuit failure propagation. Normal plugin dispatch excludes ExplicitlyLoaded plugins. Explicit mount uses the public MaxLoadingPhase=ELoadingPhase::Max default; the private external mount declaration has the same explicit default. Its numeric phase loop excludes None and ignores TryLoadModulesForPlugin return values, so mount success does not prove every module initialized successfully. Assessed the finite PluginUtils, Fab, PakFileUtilities, GDK DLC, GameFeatures and low-level-test callers with their respective gates.
